text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood! Got it! Please connect 
the feed to each stage as well, then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm hearing that every area is a 
huge success without any issues. Now 
begins Part 2... and then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"It is time for the premiere performance 
of 『GIRLS' LEGEND U』."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. This song will be performed 
simultaneously not just here on Stage A, 
but also on Stage B, Stage C... and the 
other stages as well."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The plan is for all the Umamusume to sing 
simultaneously and get hyped up right 
alongside the fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we've gathered all the strength of 
our technicians for this. We'll be sure to 
entertain you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For the Umamusume, and for the fans. —And 
for you, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ look at all these people! Everyone's 
faces show they can't wait for the show!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Today is an auspicious day, the lights are 
my lucky color... and above all, so many 
smiling faces! I can feel the good qi 
soaring through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'm gonna make every single person 
here super-duper happy☆ and max blessed☆!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing spring, summer, autumn, and 
winter, yearning and longing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's interesting, isn't this song? 
Because in the end, it connects directly 
to our running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“But that's what makes it so like us 
Umamusume. I really think the lyrics 
turned out wonderfully!”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Deep breath in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! I'm gonna pour my 
all into delivering both my song and my 
feelings to you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This Live will grant you strength! Expand 
your possibilities, elevate the utility of 
your bonds, and surpass your very limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that goes for you too, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It can't end yet! It won't end here! Let's 
all sing together! "GIRLS' LEGEND U"!

All that was left was for "GIRLS' LEGEND 
U" to play on stage—
